obfuscation_indicators: precludes detailed price and volume information
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively supported, reporting substantial revenue, gross profit, backlog, and net income improvements. Key risks include cyclical end markets, commodity and geopolitical volatility, supply-chain delays, project scheduling, customer capital spending, and uncertainty around deferred tax asset realization. The overall tone is moderately positive but includes standard forward-looking disclaimers and material operational contingencies.
